notes.title: Patch Notes 05/27/25
notes.content:
Patch Notes

Bug Fixes & Improvements
- Tutorial UI Persistence: Fixed an issue where the tutorial UI would remain indefinitely after completion.
- Disassemble Trigger Bug: Fixed a bug where the Disassemble passive did not trigger on the casting player’s screen.
- Game Over UI Misplacement: Fixed an issue where the Game Over screen would slide off in the wrong direction.
- Ice Not Clearing in Multiplayer: Fixed a bug where bots could slide on tiles that were iced earlier in the game but should have been cleared.
- Jericho Hook Multiplayer Targeting: Fixed an issue where Jericho’s grappling hook could not target Socket in multiplayer matches.
- Opto Passive Desync: Resolved frequent desync issues caused by Opto’s passive ability.
- Nail Gun Targeting Bug: Fixed an issue where the Nail Gun could not target bots.
- Network Flags on Shutdown: Closing the game now clears all network flags properly to avoid lingering data.
- Slam + Disassemble Double Trigger: Fixed a bug where the Disassemble passive would trigger multiple times when activated by a slam.
- End Turn Timing Bug: Players can no longer end their turn while actions (like enemy sliding) are still playing out, preventing unselectable bot issues.
- Health UI Persistence: Bot health bars will now remain visible and never auto-collapse.
- Attack Animation Sync: Fixed an issue where attack animations did not play for the other player in multiplayer matches.
- Place Bot Timeout Cleanup: Fixed a bug where being kicked for a placement timeout didn’t correctly clean up network state.

notes.title: Patch Notes 04/07/25
notes.content:
Patch Notes

New Features / Additions
- Shop Updates: Expanded the in-game shop with improved visuals and functionality.
- Glacies Animation: Glacies now has proper animations!
- Redesigned Wager UI: Overhauled the Wager Match interface for better clarity and polish.
- Skin Tags in Shop: Skins you already own are now labeled with a unique colored "Owned!" tag in the shop.
- Target Kill Icon: A small icon will now appear on tiles if your attack will kill a target.
- Aim Direction Improvements: Players can now aim directional abilities (like Nail Gun) by hovering anywhere on the map; the closest valid direction will be automatically selected.
- Post-Tutorial Info Text Toggle: The "How to Play" text wall no longer appears automatically after completing the tutorial. It is now opt-in from the main menu.

Bug Fixes & Improvements
- Double Damage Passive (Network)]: Fixed an issue where double damage did not trigger correctly over the network.
- Opto Heal Issues: Fixed two bugs: Opto’s healshot always healed double, and the +2 popup would show twice.
- Root Status Lasts Forever: Fixed a bug where root would persist indefinitely after status changes.
- Swap Not Completing: Fixed an issue where swap actions would occasionally not resolve.
- Update Bot Placement Mechanic: Bot placement now feels more responsive and consistent.
- Ability Timing Improvements: Added a short delay between ability effects to improve clarity and pacing.

notes.title: Patch Notes 03/13/25
notes.content:
Patch Notes

New Features / Additions
- Shop & Paint Jobs: Introduced a new in-game shop where players can purchase skins and other items using in-game coins.
- Coin-Based Purchases: Updated the shop so that all purchases now require in-game coins, which you earn after each match.
- Remote Game Settings: Added functionality for remote game setting adjustments.
- Fuel Cost Display: Ability icons now display their fuel cost, and cooldown tooltips are hidden if cooldown = 0.

Bug Fixes & Improvements
- Socket Knockback Issue: Fixed a bug where a Socket bot sliding on ice did not take knockback and then became unresponsive, preventing interaction.
- Water & Knockback Behavior: Water now correctly functions as an obstacle or applies knockback along the outer perimeter.
- Shop UI Resolution: Improved shop UI resolution for better clarity.
- Jericho's Hook Over Water: Fixed an issue where Jericho’s hook over water moved the team member in the opposite direction.
- Searching for a Match Bug: Fixed an issue where searching for a match sometimes required restarting the search.
- Main Menu Bug: Returning to the main menu now correctly resets matchmaking, preventing issues with failing to find a game.
- Fade to Black Issue: Resolved an issue where the fade-to-black transition could get stuck.
- Opto Tooltip Update: Opto's tooltip now explicitly states "Cannot destroy obstacles."
- Hill VFX Missing Texture: Fixed a missing texture in the hill VFX.
- Subscription Handling in Maintenance Phase: Refactored the maintenance phase to ensure all subscriptions call a finished function before proceeding.
- Map Selection Restrictions: You can no longer select or deselect maps while searching for a match. Map selection now happens after selecting "Find Match."
- Lower Wind Volume: Adjusted wind volume for better audio balance.
- Patch Notes Date: Added functionality to automatically include the date in patch notes.

notes.title: Patch Notes 02/25
notes.content:
Patch Notes

New Features / Additions
- Unique Music Stinger: Added a unique music stinger that plays when it’s your turn.
- Ignis Flame Blast LOS: Ignis Flame Blast now respects line of sight.

Bug Fixes & Improvements
- Deselection on Ice: Fixed a bug causing weird deselection when on ice.
- Ranking Arrow Issue: Resolved an issue where ranking up displayed incorrect arrows.
- Camera Functionality: Fixed camera issues to ensure smoother gameplay.
- Consecutive Match Error: Addressed an error that occurred when trying to play consecutive matches.

notes.title: Patch Notes 02/12/25
notes.content:
Patch Notes

New Features / Additions
- Skins Panel Relocation: Moved the Skins panel to the left side of the screen and added descriptive text for improved clarity.
- Tile Info Panel: Added a new panel that displays detailed tile information when you left-click a tile.

Bug Fixes & Improvements
- Turret Tile Occupancy: Fixed an issue where turrets were not properly occupying their designated tiles.
- Rusty's Shoulder Charge Animation: Slowed down Rusty's shoulder charge animation for a smoother visual experience.
- Opto Shooting Over Water: Resolved an issue that prevented Opto from shooting over water.
- GBL Permit Activation: Corrected the behavior so that the GBL Permit is now granted from the first mission.
- Salvage Trigger Issue: Fixed a bug where Salvage was triggered twice when two sockets were present in the match.
- Ragdoll Paint Job: Fixed an issue where ragdolls were not correctly applying the paint job.
- NailGun ROOT Effect: Resolved an issue with the NailGun not triggering the ROOT effect when knocking units into obstacles.
- Overtime Rule for 6-6 Tie: Updated the game rule so that when both teams reach 6 points simultaneously, the match continues until one team takes the lead.

notes.title: Patch Notes 01/20/2025
notes.content:
Patch Notes

New Features / Additions
- Feedback Form: An in-game feedback form has been added, making it easier than ever to send us your thoughts.
- Ranking System Tweaks: The ranking system is now more aggressive, allowing players to climb (or drop) faster.
- New GIFs for Glacies and Opto: Updated visuals for these bots, including brand-new GIFs showcasing their abilities.
- New/Updated Ability GIFs: Additional GIFs created to demonstrate newly added abilities and updates to existing ones.
- New Tutorial Mission: A fresh tutorial mission has been introduced to help newcomers understand core mechanics more effectively.

Bug Fixes
- Passive Icon Visibility: Fixed an issue preventing passive trait icons from showing.

notes.title: Patch Notes 12/5
notes.content:
Patch Notes

New Features / Additions
- Comprehensive Map Selection System: We've introduced a fully revamped map selection system. Before searching for a match, players can now choose exactly which maps they want to play on. This new feature ensures more control over your gameplay experience and a more personalized match queue.
- UI/UX Overhaul for Ranking: Redesigned the ranking interface and progression effects for a clearer, more rewarding path as you rank up.
- Player Guidance in GBL Select: Updated the interface to direct players to review passive abilities and move styles, ensuring a better understanding of their chosen characters before battle.

Bug Fixes
- Bots Stuck Red: Fixed an issue where bots could remain in a red state after taking damage rapidly.
- NPC Pathfinding: Resolved a bug causing NPCs to fail to navigate properly.
- Stop Searching Button: Fixed an issue where the Stop Searching button would not function, allowing players to properly cancel matchmaking searches.

notes.title: Patch Notes 11/11
notes.content:
Patch Notes

New Features / Additions
- Networking: Refactored networking code to vastly improve stability
- Color-Coded Passive Abilities: Added color-coded Pop-ups to indicate when passive abilities are triggered for better visual feedback.

Bug Fixes
- Knockback not Triggering Slam: Fixed an issue where knockback was not triggering the slam effect.
- Turrets Not Occupying Tiles: Resolved an issue where turrets were not occupying tiles in some cases, and refreshed the occupy system to track destructible obstacles correctly.

notes.title: Patch Notes 10/15
notes.content:
Patch Notes

New Features / Additions
- Match Found Transition: Added visual feedback on the waiting screen when a match is found, with a smooth transition into the game.
- New 3D Model for Glacies: Glacies has received a brand-new 3D model.
- New VFX for Shoulder Charge: Introduced new visual effects for Rusty’s Shoulder Charge ability.
- Bot Info View During Opponent's Turn: Players can now inspect both their own and enemy bots even when it is not their turn.

Bug Fixes
- Settings Menu Flickering: Fixed an issue where the settings menu would flicker when opened.
- Objective Tiles Stopping Ice Movement: Resolved an issue where objective tiles incorrectly halted ice-based movement.
- Salvage Triggers Twice: Fixed a bug where the Salvage action triggered twice.
- Snowball Hover Bug: Fixed an issue where snowballs stayed on tiles when hovering.
- Ranking System Fix: Resolved issues with the ranking system for more accurate player ranking.
- Game Packet Synchronization: Fixed a bug where game packets were sent back to the last turn. Now checks the time of the last packet and discards old packets.
- Turn Tracker Bug: Created and fixed trackers (e.g., turn count at the end of the game).

General Improvements
- Ability Name and Description Normalization: Updated and normalized the flavor text for ability names and descriptions for better consistency.

notes.title: Patch Notes 9/09/24
notes.content:
Changes

 Glacie Icon and Ability Update: Updated Glacie's icons and ability descriptions for better clarity.
 Opto Heal Projectile Visibility: Improved the visibility of Opto’s heal projectile to make it clearer during gameplay.

Bug Fixes

 Status Effect Phase Delay: Fixed an issue where the status effect phase was delayed.
 Double Damage Passive (Network Issue): Resolved a bug where the double damage passive did not properly trigger over the network.
 Scenario Fuel Bug: Fixed a bug where finishing a scenario with exactly 0 fuel caused the player to skip their first turn in the next scenario instance.
 Second Socket Mission: Fixed an issue in the second socket mission where placing the first turret did not consume fuel.
 Turn Not Ending After Fuel Depletion: Addressed a bug where using all fuel in a mission would not end the player’s turn.
 Incorrect Text on Breakable Objects: Corrected the text to clarify that players can only break cities, not mountains or trees.
 Controller Unresponsiveness After Leaving Game: Fixed an issue where game controllers became unresponsive after exiting the game.
 Rusty Shoulder Charge Desync: Resolved a desync issue where Rusty’s shoulder charge on ice caused self-damage and death for one player but not the other.
 Shoulder Charge Over Ice: Implemented a temporary fix to prevent damage while shoulder charging over ice to address broken mechanics.
 Null Reference Error: Fixed a null reference error that occurred when one player left the game.
 Send Feedback Button Freezing: Fixed an issue where the "Send Feedback" button would freeze the game.

notes.title: Patch Notes 8/30
notes.content:
Game Release Notes / Patch Notes

New Features / Additions
- Added Two new Bots: Glacies and Opto
- Dynamic News Integration: Set up Playfab Dynamic News data for real-time updates.
- Server-Side Map Data: Changed map data to be pulled from server-authoritative JSON files to prevent desync issues.
- Multiplayer Maps: Introduced new multiplayer maps.
- Automatic Camera Focus: Implemented automatic camera focus on enemy units after a bot ends its turn.
- Snowball Mechanics: Enhanced snowball behavior to extend 1 tile past ice and continue moving forward until it hits a non-ice tile.
- Glacie Animations: Added ragdoll and placement animations for Glacie.
- Tooltip Priority: Updated tooltip priority on Opto to display "On Cooldown" before "Not Enough Fuel" when out of fuel.
- End Turn Deselect: All bots are now deselected automatically when ending a turn.

Bug Fixes
- Multiplayer Scoring Issue: Fixed an issue where a player could win with only 2 points in multiplayer mode.
- Jericho Teleport Desync: Resolved a desync issue caused by Jericho’s teleport ability.
- Victory Screen Performance: Addressed significant FPS drops in the victory screen for lower-end hardware.
- Socket Turret Placement: Fixed an issue where attempting to place a Socket Turret on an ice ball would consume fuel but not place the turret.
- Rusty's Hammer Lock: Fixed an issue where players could become locked into the move selector after Rusty’s hammer killed an allied Glacie on a hill.
- Rusty Knockback: Corrected Rusty's knockback direction to function as intended, knocking enemies sideways instead of forwards.
- Snowball Travel: Fixed an issue where snowballs wouldn’t travel across all ice tiles.
